project (https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders), originally
licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Files retaining the upstream

of that upstream code, as indicated by the "Modified by USTC-StarTeam" notice
appended to their headers.

========================================================================
THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS
========================================================================

The following files incorporate code distributed under the MIT License
(https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT). The MIT copyright and permission
notices are retained in each file's header.

- generative_recommenders/modeling/sequential/mamba4rec.py
    Contains code from Mamba4Rec by Chengkai Liu et al.
    (https://github.com/chengkai-liu/Mamba4Rec), MIT License.
    Original algorithm: Liu et al., "Mamba4Rec: Towards Efficient Sequential
    Recommendation with Selective State Space Models", arXiv:2403.03900, 2024.

- generative_recommenders/modeling/sequential/ttt4rec.py
    Contains code from TTT4Rec by Zhaoqi Yang et al.
    (https://github.com/ZhaoqiZachYang/TTT4Rec), MIT License.
    Original algorithm: Yang et al., "TTT4Rec: A Test-Time Training Approach
    for Rapid Adaption in Sequential Recommendation", arXiv:2409.19142, 2024.

- generative_recommenders/modeling/sequential/tim4rec.py
    Contains code from Hao Fan (TiM4Rec implementation), MIT License.

- generative_recommenders/modeling/sequential/ssd.py
    Contains code from Hao Fan, MIT License.

- generative_recommenders/modeling/sequential/ttt.py
    Copied from test-time-training/ttt-lm-pytorch
    (https://github.com/test-time-training/ttt-lm-pytorch), MIT License.
